Optional groups: Reclaim Cards and Gain Power Card; OR Add Presence Range 1 and +1 Card Play this turn; OR Gain Power Card and +3 Energy. Steady Regeneration at approximately [30,1510,1040,1780]; Growth [1040,20,2670,370]. Choke is a separate rule, not the source of Regeneration permission.
